summary: Ragdoll physics and noise-rule horror lead the breakout charts again, and both now reach Most Popular: Realistic Ragdoll Engine entered at 16 days and DONT SPLASH is among its best at 11 days.
The Hollow, Roblox's own event hub, is on Most Popular, Top Trending and Up-and-Coming at once, and participating games such as Banana Eats tag it in their titles.
Games pull players first and monetize later: the newest games lead Up-and-Coming and Top Trending while Top Earning efficiency rises steadily with age.
